rules.response_en:
🌧️ MONSOON ONSET - SUGARCANE ADVISORY:

✅ PREPARATION:
• Complete earthing up before heavy rains
• Apply remaining N-fertilizer in splits
• Clean drainage channels
• Install light traps for borer moths

⚠️ WATCH FOR:
• Waterlogging after heavy rains
• Fungal diseases (Pokkah Boeng)
• Reduced pest spraying opportunity
• Weed flush - timely control needed

📋 Monsoon is GRAND GROWTH phase - critical for yield!
rules.response_hi:
🌧️ मानसून शुरू - गन्ना सलाह:

✅ भारी बारिश से पहले मिट्टी चढ़ाएं, जल निकासी साफ करें
⚠️ जलभराव, फफूंद रोग, खरपतवार पर ध्यान दें
rules.response_mr:
🌧️ मान्सून सुरुवात - ऊस सल्ला:

✅ जोरदार पावसापूर्वी मातीची भर द्या, निचरा स्वच्छ करा
⚠️ पाणी साचणे, बुरशीजन्य रोग, तणांवर लक्ष ठेवा

rules.response_en:
🌧️ HEAVY RAIN ALERT (>100mm expected):

✅ BEFORE RAIN:
• Open all drainage outlets
• Postpone any scheduled spraying
• Prop tall canes if possible

✅ AFTER RAIN:
• Drain excess water within 48 hours
• Check for lodging - prop immediately
• Monitor for disease outbreak (3-5 days later)
• Spray fungicide if prolonged wet weather

⚠️ Heavy rain + wind = lodging risk
⚠️ Stagnant water >5 days = major yield loss
rules.response_hi:
🌧️ भारी बारिश चेतावनी (>100mm):

✅ पहले: जल निकासी खोलें, छिड़काव टालें
✅ बाद में: 48 घंटे में पानी निकालें, गिरने की जांच करें
rules.response_mr:
🌧️ जोरदार पाऊस इशारा (>100mm):

✅ आधी: निचरा उघडा, फवारणी पुढे ढकला
✅ नंतर: 48 तासांत पाणी काढा, पडणे तपासा

rules.response_en:
☀️ DRY SPELL DURING MONSOON (No rain >15 days):

⚠️ CRITICAL for Grand Growth stage!

✅ IMMEDIATE:
• Life-saving irrigation essential
• One irrigation can save 30% yield loss
• Apply mulch if available

✅ SPRAY:
• KCl 1% for stress tolerance
• Reduce N-fertilizer by 25%

📊 Yield loss: 5-7% per day of stress during this phase

⚠️ July-August dry spells are common - keep irrigation ready!
rules.response_hi:
☀️ मानसून में सूखा (15+ दिन बारिश नहीं):

⚠️ भव्य वृद्धि के लिए गंभीर!
✅ तुरंत सिंचाई करें - एक सिंचाई 30% नुकसान बचा सकती है
rules.response_mr:
☀️ मान्सूनमध्ये खंड (15+ दिवस पाऊस नाही):

⚠️ ग्रँड ग्रोथसाठी गंभीर!
✅ तात्काळ पाणी द्या - एक पाणी 30% नुकसान वाचवू शकते

rules.response_en:
🌡️ HEATWAVE ALERT (>42°C for 3+ days):

✅ MANAGEMENT:
• Increase irrigation frequency (every 5-7 days)
• Irrigate in evening (cooler soil overnight)
• Apply trash mulch (reduces soil temperature by 5-8°C)
• Spray 2% Kaolin (reflective coating)
• Avoid fertilizer application during peak heat

⚠️ AVOID:
• Spraying pesticides (phytotoxicity risk)
• Field operations during afternoon

📊 Growth stops above 45°C
rules.response_hi:
🌡️ लू चेतावनी (>42°C):

✅ सिंचाई बढ़ाएं, शाम को पानी दें, मल्चिंग करें
⚠️ दोपहर में छिड़काव/खेत कार्य टालें
rules.response_mr:
🌡️ उष्णतेची लाट (>42°C):

✅ पाणी वाढवा, संध्याकाळी पाणी द्या, आच्छादन करा
⚠️ दुपारी फवारणी/शेतकाम टाळा

rules.response_en:
❄️ COLD WAVE ALERT (<10°C for 3+ days):

✅ PROTECTION:
• Light irrigation before cold night (soil releases heat)
• Trash mulch protects roots
• Avoid nitrogen during cold (can't be utilized)
• Create smoke screens on coldest nights (traditional method)

⚠️ FROST RISK:
• If ground frost expected, irrigate in evening
• Harvest mature cane before severe frost

📊 Germination stops below 12°C
📊 Frost damages leaves and inverts sugar
rules.response_hi:
❄️ शीत लहर चेतावनी (<10°C):

✅ ठंडी रात से पहले सिंचाई, मल्चिंग, धुआं
⚠️ पाला जोखिम: गंभीर पाले से पहले परिपक्व गन्ना काटें
rules.response_mr:
❄️ थंडीची लाट (<10°C):

✅ थंड रात्रीपूर्वी पाणी, आच्छादन, धूर
⚠️ दव धोका: तीव्र दवापूर्वी परिपक्व ऊस कापा

rules.response_en:
🌀 CYCLONE/STORM ALERT:

✅ BEFORE STORM:
• Harvest mature cane if time permits
• Open all drainage outlets
• Secure farm equipment

✅ AFTER STORM:
• Assess damage for insurance (photo document)
• Prop lodged canes within 48 hours
• Drain waterlogged areas immediately
• Spray fungicide to prevent disease
• Apply 25 kg N/ha for recovery

📋 INSURANCE: Report to insurance within 48-72 hours

⚠️ Don't enter field until safe
rules.response_hi:
🌀 चक्रवात/तूफान चेतावनी:

✅ पहले: परिपक्व गन्ना काटें, जल निकासी खोलें
✅ बाद में: बीमा के लिए फोटो, 48 घंटे में गिरे गन्ने उठाएं
rules.response_mr:
🌀 चक्रीवादळ/वादळ इशारा:

✅ आधी: परिपक्व ऊस कापा, निचरा उघडा
✅ नंतर: विम्यासाठी फोटो, 48 तासांत पडलेले ऊस उभे करा

rules.response_en:
📅 OPTIMAL PLANTING WEATHER:

✅ BEST CONDITIONS:
• Temperature: 25-32°C
• Soil moisture: Adequate (not waterlogged)
• Season: Feb-Mar (Adsali), Oct-Nov (Pre-seasonal), Jan-Feb (Seasonal)

📊 REGIONAL TIMING:
• Maharashtra: Oct-Nov (best), Feb-Mar
• UP/Bihar: Feb-Mar, Oct
• Tamil Nadu: Dec-Jan
• Karnataka: Jul-Aug

⚠️ Avoid planting during:
• Peak summer (>40°C) - poor germination
• Heavy monsoon - waterlogging
• Winter (<15°C) - slow germination
rules.response_hi:
📅 इष्टतम रोपण मौसम:

✅ सर्वोत्तम: तापमान 25-32°C, पर्याप्त नमी
📊 क्षेत्र के अनुसार समय चुनें
rules.response_mr:
📅 इष्टतम लागवड हवामान:

✅ सर्वोत्तम: तापमान 25-32°C, पुरेसा ओलावा
📊 प्रदेशानुसार वेळ निवडा

rules.response_en:
🌾 HARVEST WEATHER CONSIDERATIONS:

✅ IDEAL HARVEST WEATHER:
• Dry conditions (no rain expected 3-4 days)
• Cool mornings (early cutting easier)
• Road access for transport

⚠️ AVOID HARVEST WHEN:
• Frost just occurred (wait 24 hours)
• Heavy rain expected (muddy fields)
• During heatwave (rapid sugar loss)

📊 SUGAR RECOVERY:
• Best: Cool, dry months (Nov-Mar)
• Worst: Peak summer, monsoon

⚠️ Stop irrigation 15-20 days before harvest for sugar concentration
rules.response_hi:
🌾 कटाई मौसम:

✅ आदर्श: सूखी स्थिति, ठंडी सुबह
⚠️ टालें: पाला, भारी बारिश, लू के दौरान
rules.response_mr:
🌾 कापणी हवामान:

✅ आदर्श: कोरडी स्थिती, थंड सकाळ
⚠️ टाळा: दव, जोरदार पाऊस, उष्णतेच्या लाटेत

rules.response_en:
💨 SPRAY WEATHER GUIDELINES:

✅ IDEAL CONDITIONS:
• Temperature: 25-30°C
• Wind: <10 km/hr
• Humidity: 60-80%
• Time: Early morning (6-9 AM) or late evening (4-6 PM)
• No rain for 4-6 hours after spray

🚫 AVOID SPRAYING:
• Wind >15 km/hr (drift to other crops)
• Temperature >35°C (evaporation loss)
• Bright midday sun (phytotoxicity)
• Rain expected within 4 hours

📋 Check weather forecast before mixing pesticides!
rules.response_hi:
💨 छिड़काव मौसम:

✅ आदर्श: 25-30°C, हवा <10 km/hr, सुबह/शाम
🚫 तेज हवा, गर्मी, दोपहर धूप, बारिश से बचें
rules.response_mr:
💨 फवारणी हवामान:

✅ आदर्श: 25-30°C, वारा <10 km/hr, सकाळ/संध्याकाळ
🚫 तीव्र वारा, उष्णता, दुपारचे ऊन, पाऊस टाळा

rules.response_en:
💧 WEATHER-BASED IRRIGATION:

📊 ADJUSTMENTS:
• Hot/windy day: Increase frequency by 20-30%
• Cloudy/cool day: Reduce by 20%
• After rain: Skip irrigation if >25mm received
• Winter: Extend interval by 3-5 days

✅ BEST PRACTICE:
• Monitor soil moisture, not calendar
• Night irrigation in summer (less evaporation)
• Morning irrigation in winter (warmer soil)

📋 ET-based scheduling saves 15-20% water
rules.response_hi:
💧 मौसम आधारित सिंचाई:

📊 गर्म दिन: 20-30% बढ़ाएं | ठंडा दिन: 20% कम करें
✅ मिट्टी नमी देखें, कैलेंडर नहीं
rules.response_mr:
💧 हवामानावर आधारित सिंचन:

📊 उष्ण दिवस: 20-30% वाढवा | थंड दिवस: 20% कमी करा
✅ माती ओलावा बघा, कॅलेंडर नाही

rules.response_en:
🐛 WEATHER-PEST FORECAST:

📊 HIGH PEST RISK CONDITIONS:

🌧️ HUMID/RAINY:
• Pyrilla, Woolly Aphid outbreak
• Fungal diseases (Red Rot, Smut)
• Release biocontrol before monsoon

☀️ HOT/DRY:
• Scale insects, Mites
• Termite activity increases
• Borer moth emergence after first rain

❄️ COOL:
• Reduced pest activity (good for IPM)
• Disease spread slower

✅ Install light traps 2-3 weeks before expected moth emergence
rules.response_hi:
🐛 मौसम-कीट पूर्वानुमान:

📊 आर्द्र/वर्षा: पायरिला, ऊनी मोहा, फफूंद रोग
📊 गर्म/सूखा: स्केल, दीमक, छेदक
rules.response_mr:
🐛 हवामान-कीटक अंदाज:

📊 दमट/पाऊस: पायरिला, लोकरी माव, बुरशी रोग
📊 उष्ण/कोरडे: स्केल, वाळवी, पोखरणारे

rules.response_en:
🧪 FERTILIZER APPLICATION WEATHER:

✅ IDEAL:
• After light rain or irrigation
• Soil moist but not waterlogged
• No heavy rain expected for 24 hours

🚫 AVOID:
• Dry soil (fertilizer won't dissolve)
• Waterlogged soil (N loss by leaching)
• Before heavy rain (wash-off)
• During drought stress (plant can't utilize)
• Peak heat (volatilization loss)

📋 Best: Apply N in 2-3 splits with earthing up
rules.response_hi:
🧪 उर्वरक मौसम:

✅ आदर्श: हल्की बारिश/सिंचाई के बाद, नम मिट्टी
🚫 सूखी/जलभराव, भारी बारिश से पहले, सूखे में टालें
rules.response_mr:
🧪 खत हवामान:

✅ आदर्श: हलक्या पावसानंतर/पाण्यानंतर, ओलसर माती
🚫 कोरडी/पाणथळ, जोरदार पावसापूर्वी, दुष्काळात टाळा
